theirReference: Staying with Christian was a wonderful experience. Even before I arrived in Bogotá, he was incredibly helpful, answering my questions and giving me tips about the city. When I got there, his whole family welcomed me warmly; I had the chance to meet his mom, brother, girlfriend, and their pets, which made me feel right at home. Christian and his girlfriend showed me around their city and recommended great places to eat, visit, and even shop for souvenirs. They truly went out of their way to make my stay memorable. I absolutely recommend Christian to anyone traveling to Colombia. You’ll feel safe, welcomed, and very well taken care of!
myReference: I had the chance to host Esther and it was a truly great experience. She is very easygoing, friendly, respectful, and has a wonderful positive vibe. We spent some time exploring together — we walked around La Candelaria, shared stories, and enjoyed some local food like empanadas and almojábanas. Esther was always open to learning, discovering new places, and experiencing the city with a positive attitude. She was very easy to live with and left a genuinely good impression. 😁 I fully recommend her to any future host — she’s reliable, fun, and very considerate. Always welcome 🤗
